rule_gaps: the brand name 'Hobby' (Dohse aquaristics, sold by Zooservice) is read as our Hobby category — 5 aquarium products landed here; a leading brand token should not resolve a category on its own
'lerret' matches the art-supplies vocabulary even in 'Innredning/Interiør > Bilder & kunst > Lerretsbilder' — finished canvas prints belong to Home, only blank stretched canvas is Hobby
'strikket'/'strikk' pulls finished knitwear (jumpers, scarves) out of Fashion into Hobby
'hårstrikk'/'hårpynt' is unmapped and falls through to Hobby; it should reach Beauty (Jewelry when the piece is silver)
facetrules colour table misses the Norwegian/retail colour words 'kurry', 'rose', 'lilac', 'lyng', 'rustrød', 'sitrongul', 'lysrosa', 'lyseblå', 'pastellrosa' and 'crimson'
Tegne.no rows carry no brand at all: for these feeds the leading name token (Gütermann, Hama, Kaweco, Koh-i-Noor, Kremer, Joy!Crafts) is the brand — 72 rows on this shard alone
brushes and brush sets get facets.type 'Paint' rather than 'Painting supplies' (not fixed here, but it makes the Paint option meaningless on this category)
notes: Healthy on category by volume (the shard is genuinely craft/art/sewing) but it is dominated by one shop's un-grouped SKU sprawl: 51 variant families (mostly Prym buttons and Gütermann thread colour numbers) sit as 130 separate top-level rows, and 72 rows have no brand though the name states one. The real category damage is concentrated: 5 aquarium products from a pet shop, 5 canvas wall prints, 7 hair ties and 2 finished knitwear garments. Images are missing on roughly half the shard, which is expected for sampled shops and not reported per row.
